notes: Starter component library for aquaponics simulation assembly.
Placeholder values are used where evidence-backed specifications are not yet available.
All starter components are marked draft until component-specific evidence is collected.

water_loop_components.name: Fish Tank

notes: Placeholder tank cost and maintenance interval.
Acts as the main livestock process vessel.

water_loop_components.name: Sump Tank
water_loop_components.role: Collects return water and stabilizes loop volume before recirculation.
notes: Placeholder values for a basic sump vessel.
Often used as the pump draw point in coupled systems.

water_loop_components.name: Biofilter
water_loop_components.role: Supports nitrifying bacteria for TAN and nitrite conversion.
notes: Placeholder biofilter economics and service interval.
Critical component for ammonia control.

Feed-based sizing anchors from the distilled pack: fluidized sand about 16 to 32 kg feed/m3 media/day, MBBR about 8 to 16 kg feed/m3 media/day, and bead systems about 16 to 32 kg feed/m3 media/day when washing is adequate.
Nitrification stoichiometry anchors from the distilled pack: oxygen demand about 4.57 g O2 per g TAN-N and alkalinity demand about 7.14 g CaCO3 per g TAN-N.
Startup and maturation are modeled as a lagged ramp rather than instant full capacity.

water_loop_components.name: Solids Filter
water_loop_components.role: Removes suspended solids before downstream biological treatment.
notes: Placeholder maintenance assumes routine cleaning.
Solids management can indirectly reduce oxygen demand and ammonia release.
Settling clarifier anchor from the distilled pack: design around 15 to 30 minutes HRT, with aquaponics operational corroboration around 19 to 20 minutes and weaker capture near about 9.5 minutes.
Radial-flow settlers outperform swirl separators on mean TSS removal under the distilled-pack comparison.
